raw_founder_input: I keep seeing B2B SaaS teams ship 'chat with your data' sidebars that look great in sales demos, but nobody uses them after week 2. The real winners trigger AI on background events, show inline diffs instead of chat walls, and learn from user edits.

slides.headline: Why 90% of B2B AI Features Become Ghost Towns After Launch
slides.body: And the 3-layer product architecture top SaaS founders use to turn a 'cool sales demo' into a daily workflow habit.
callout_bullets: Industry benchmark for bolt-on 'Chat with your data' sidebars across B2B SaaS products in 2026.

slides.headline: Users Don't Want Another Empty Text Box
slides.body: When you ship a generic AI chat sidebar, you shift 100% of the cognitive load onto a busy operator:
callout_bullets: [X] 'What prompt should I even type right now?'
[X] 'Does it have context from this customer record?'
[X] 'Can I trust this output in front of my VP?'

slides.headline: Chat Interfaces Optimize for Demos, Not Throughput
slides.body: Buyers clap on the sales call. Operators abandon it by week two because typing prompts is slower than clicking a button.
callout_bullets: If your AI feature requires >8 words of user typing to complete a recurring task, week-4 usage drops by 70%+.

slides.headline: 1. Event-Triggered Execution (No Prompting)
slides.body: Don't wait for the user to ask. Trigger AI jobs automatically in the background on system events:
callout_bullets: [*] Call ends -> Pre-draft CRM stage & MEDDIC fields
[*] Ticket arrives -> Attach root-cause log snippet
[*] PR opened -> Flag breaking API schema changes

slides.headline: 2. Inline Diff UI Instead of Walls of Text
slides.body: Never dump 400 words in a chat bubble. Present AI work as an inline diff right inside the system of record.
callout_bullets: [+] Highlight exact fields being added or modified

slides.headline: 3. Implicit Feedback Loops From User Edits
slides.body: Less than 2% of users click thumbs-up/down. Instead, capture the delta between what AI proposed and what the user saved.
callout_bullets: Products that learn automatically from user edit diffs see 3.8x higher Week-8 retention than static prompts.

slides.body: Score your current roadmap against these four shifts before your next sprint planning:
callout_bullets: 2. Blank Text Box ---> Pre-Filled Action Draft
3. Uncited Paragraph ---> Inline Field Diff + Source

slides.headline: Make AI Invisible in the UI, Undeniable in the Outcome.
slides.body: Audit your #1 AI feature today: Can your user get verifiable value in ONE single click without typing a word?

post_caption:
Why 90% of B2B AI Features Become Ghost Towns After Launch

Benchmark: 68% of first-time SaaS AE hires before $1.5M ARR miss quota and churn within 9 months.

Prospects don't ghost after demos because of price—they ghost because their internal champion lacks a 1-page CFO business case.

Here is the 3-part architecture winning right now:
1. Diagnose the #1 hair-on-fire bottleneck before showing a single screen
2. Replace open-ended 'free trials' with a 14-day Paid Pilot & 3 success criteria
3. Arm your buyer champion with a 1-page Forwardable Executive Memo
